quote: When the v2026.9.5 Mac app loads this dashboard from an updated Gateway, its native bridge rejects `chrome-extension-status`. The result stays null, so this condition removes the previously working setup button permanently.
note: The P1 item “Preserve Chrome setup for shipped Mac app versions” identifies both the rejected status request that hides Setup and the older installation reply that lacks `installedProfiles`. It remained open at merge, and no human responded in the bundle.
